report.headline: Crunchies Cream Biscuits 100g went out of stock at Mumbai DC on 31 Jul.
report.narrative: Safety stock was set too low for demand variability, causing stock to fall 31.0% below the safety buffer, owned by inventory policy and planning. DC replenishment planning ordered 19.6% less than needed, compounding the shortfall.

causes.cause: Safety stock set too low for demand variability
causes.action: Review safety stock for Crunchies Cream Biscuits 100g at Mumbai DC: stock sat below the buffer on 31% of days (off target in 8 of the last 12 weeks), so the buffer does not cover demand variability.
Check Mumbai DC's order quantities against policy: orders fell 20% short of what the inventory norm required.

ruled_out.why: 99.3% vs threshold below 95%: within normal range
-1.6% vs threshold above 10%: within normal range

confirmed_causes.cause: Safety stock set too low for demand variability

provenance.sql:
SELECT 1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN delivery_date <= required_delivery_date
                      THEN COALESCE(accepted_qty, 0) ELSE 0 END)
       / NULLIF(SUM(ordered_qty), 0) AS value,
       COUNT(*) AS orders_in_window, SUM(ordered_qty) AS ordered_qty
FROM scm_orders.replenishment_orders
WHERE sku_id = '300452' AND dc_id = 'DC1'
  AND required_delivery_date BETWEEN date_sub(DATE '2026-07-31', 84) AND date_sub(DATE '2026-07-31', 1)

SELECT 1.0 * (SUM(actual_demand_qty) - SUM(forecast_qty))
       / NULLIF(SUM(actual_demand_qty), 0) AS value,
       SUM(actual_demand_qty) AS actual_demand_qty, SUM(forecast_qty) AS forecast_qty
FROM scm_planning_01.demand_daily
WHERE sku_id = '300452' AND dc_id = 'DC1' AND demand_date BETWEEN date_sub(DATE '2026-07-31', 84) AND date_sub(DATE '2026-07-31', 1)

SELECT 1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN s.days_on_hand < n.safety_stock_days THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
       / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS value,
       SUM(CASE WHEN s.days_on_hand < n.safety_stock_days THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS breach_days,
       COUNT(*) AS days_observed, MAX(n.safety_stock_days) AS safety_stock_days
FROM scm_wms.inventory_snapshots s
JOIN scm_wms.inventory_norms n ON s.sku_id = n.sku_id AND s.dc_id = n.dc_id
WHERE s.sku_id = '300452' AND s.dc_id = 'DC1' AND s.snapshot_date BETWEEN date_sub(DATE '2026-07-31', 84) AND date_sub(DATE '2026-07-31', 1)

SELECT s.snapshot_date, s.on_hand_qty, s.days_on_hand, n.safety_stock_days
FROM scm_wms.inventory_snapshots s
JOIN scm_wms.inventory_norms n ON s.sku_id = n.sku_id AND s.dc_id = n.dc_id
WHERE s.sku_id = '300452' AND s.dc_id = 'DC1' AND s.snapshot_date BETWEEN date_sub(DATE '2026-07-31', 84) AND date_sub(DATE '2026-07-31', 1)
ORDER BY s.snapshot_date

WITH actual AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ordered_qty), 0) AS qty
  FROM scm_orders.replenishment_orders
  WHERE sku_id = '300452' AND dc_id = 'DC1' AND required_delivery_date BETWEEN date_sub(DATE '2026-07-31', 84) AND date_sub(DATE '2026-07-31', 1)),
inv_d1 AS (
  SELECT on_hand_qty FROM scm_wms.inventory_snapshots
  WHERE sku_id = '300452' AND dc_id = 'DC1'
    AND snapshot_date = date_sub(DATE '2026-07-31', 84 + 1)),
design_d AS (
  SELECT s.fwd_avg_daily_forecast * n.inventory_norm_days AS qty
  FROM scm_wms.inventory_snapshots s
  JOIN scm_wms.inventory_norms n ON s.sku_id = n.sku_id AND s.dc_id = n.dc_id
  WHERE s.sku_id = '300452' AND s.dc_id = 'DC1'
    AND s.snapshot_date = date_sub(DATE '2026-07-31', 1)),
fc AS (
  SELECT SUM(forecast_qty) AS qty FROM scm_planning_01.demand_daily
  WHERE sku_id = '300452' AND dc_id = 'DC1' AND demand_date BETWEEN date_sub(DATE '2026-07-31', 84) AND date_sub(DATE '2026-07-31', 1))
SELECT 1 - 1.0 * a.qty / NULLIF(GREATEST(0, dd.qty - i.on_hand_qty + f.qty), 0) AS value,
       a.qty AS actual_ordered_qty,
       GREATEST(0, dd.qty - i.on_hand_qty + f.qty) AS theoretical_order_qty
FROM actual a CROSS JOIN inv_d1 i CROSS JOIN design_d dd CROSS JOIN fc f

SELECT order_id, ordered_qty, accepted_qty, dispatch_date, required_delivery_date,
       delivery_date, std_lead_time_days
FROM scm_orders.replenishment_orders
WHERE sku_id = '300452' AND dc_id = 'DC1' AND required_delivery_date BETWEEN date_sub(DATE '2026-07-31', 84) AND date_sub(DATE '2026-07-31', 1)
ORDER BY required_delivery_date

evidence.label: Breach onset test (first 6 vs last 6 of the 12 weeks)

provenance.sql:
SELECT 1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN s.snapshot_date < date_sub(DATE '2026-07-31', 42)
                       AND s.days_on_hand < n.safety_stock_days THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
       / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN s.snapshot_date < date_sub(DATE '2026-07-31', 42) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS early_rate,
       1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN s.snapshot_date >= date_sub(DATE '2026-07-31', 42)
                       AND s.days_on_hand < n.safety_stock_days THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
       / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN s.snapshot_date >= date_sub(DATE '2026-07-31', 42) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS late_rate,
       COUNT(*) AS days_observed
FROM scm_wms.inventory_snapshots s
JOIN scm_wms.inventory_norms n ON s.sku_id = n.sku_id AND s.dc_id = n.dc_id
WHERE s.sku_id = '300452' AND s.dc_id = 'DC1' AND s.snapshot_date BETWEEN date_sub(DATE '2026-07-31', 84) AND date_sub(DATE '2026-07-31', 1)

SELECT SUM(actual_demand_qty - fulfilled_qty) AS lost_units,
       SUM(CASE WHEN actual_demand_qty > fulfilled_qty THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS short_days
FROM scm_planning_01.demand_daily
WHERE sku_id = '300452' AND dc_id = 'DC1' AND demand_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-31' AND date_sub(DATE '2026-07-31', -27)
